annotations.title: Record an ad or campaign in Shopify > Marketing

description: Record an ad or campaign the merchant is running (on Meta, Google, TikTok, email, anywhere) in their Shopify admin under Marketing, so Shopify's own reports attribute storefront visits and sales to it by its UTM. REPORTING ONLY: it publishes nothing and spends nothing. Pass title, remoteUrl (where the ad is managed, e.g. the Ads Manager link), the utm {campaign, source, medium} the ad's links carry, and optionally tactic (AD default, RETARGETING, POST, LINK, NEWSLETTER, …), channel (SOCIAL default, SEARCH, DISPLAY, EMAIL, REFERRAL), status (ACTIVE default, PAUSED, SCHEDULED, INACTIVE, DELETED_EXTERNALLY), budget {type DAILY|LIFETIME, amount, currency}, adSpend {amount, currency}, start / end / scheduledEnd dates and previewImageUrl. remoteId is YOUR stable id for the activity (the ad platform's campaign id is ideal); calling again with the same remoteId UPDATES that one row, and every field you leave out is KEPT from the existing record (Shopify's own upsert would erase it; the reply lists what was kept). Read back from Shopify. Needs the store to have approved Hermoso's marketing permission: if it has not, the reply says to open Hermoso once from the Shopify admin to approve it. Only works for accounts created by installing Hermoso from the Shopify App Store. Free.

budget.description: budget object: {type DAILY or LIFETIME, amount, currency}

amount.description: budget amount, in the currency given

campaignId.description: the ad platform campaign id; only used to derive remoteId

channel.description: SOCIAL, SEARCH, DISPLAY, EMAIL or REFERRAL; default SOCIAL

platform.description: where it runs, e.g. meta, google_ads, tiktok_ads; only used to derive remoteId

previewImageUrl.description: https image shown next to the activity (the ad creative works)

remoteId.description: your stable id for this activity (e.g. the ad platform campaign id); derived from platform + campaignId or the utm campaign when omitted

remoteUrl.description: https link where this ad or campaign is managed or viewed; required on the first recording

scheduledEnd.description: ISO date the activity is scheduled to end

status.description: ACTIVE, PAUSED, SCHEDULED, INACTIVE, DELETED_EXTERNALLY or UNDEFINED; default ACTIVE

tactic.description: Shopify marketing tactic, e.g. AD, RETARGETING, POST, NEWSLETTER; default AD

title.description: what the merchant sees in Shopify > Marketing; required on the first recording

utm.description: the UTM the ad links carry; Shopify matches visits on all three

campaign.description: utm_campaign value the ad's links carry; Shopify matches visits on all three UTM fields

medium.description: utm_medium value the ad's links carry

source.description: utm_source value the ad's links carry

name: record_shopify_marketing_activity
title: Record an ad or campaign in Shopify > Marketing
